description: Image Description: The image depicts a vast, open savannah landscape under a clear sky. Two zebras, with their distinctive black and white stripes, are walking across the dry, grassy terrain. The zebras are positioned towards the center of the image, with one slightly ahead of the other, both facing away from the viewer. In the distance, there are low bushes and trees scattered along the horizon, adding depth to the scene. The overall ambiance is calm and natural, showcasing a typical wildlife setting
